name: Android Production App Bundle Continuous Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  deploy-android:
    name: Build and Package Signed Android App Bundle
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js Build Environment
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Setup Java Development Kit (JDK) Env
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Ruby and Bundler Subsystems
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install Application Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Inject Production Signing Keystore Payload
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 --decode > android/app/production.keystore
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}

      - name: Execute Fastlane Ingress & Compile Lane
        run: bundle exec fastlane android build_production_release
        env:
          AKNOWLOGE_RELEASE_STORE_FILE: "production.keystore"
          AKNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.AKNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          AKNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.AKNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS }}
          AKNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.AKNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
